title: feat(ui): an edit form's state-machine select offers only the moves the server accepts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi955CwQcSiWwJCH5htb8Ncqt)_
Part of #25933 — this PR is the edit form half; the board half (drop gate on the Kanban columns) follows in a second PR from the same branch.

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

An object whose field is governed by an error-severity `state_machine` validation (the showcase task's `status`, for one) used to offer every option in the record edit form. The server refused the invalid move only after submit, with "Invalid task status transition." and no list of the allowed next states. The edit form now offers the persisted value plus the states the machine declares as its next moves, and leaves the rest out.

- **`@object-ui/core` — new export `stateMachineNextValues(objectSchema, fieldName, currentValue)`** in `validation/validators/state-machine-next-values.ts`, published through the validators barrel. It was the grid's private helper (`plugin-grid/src/inline-edit-options.ts`); it now narrows exactly where the server's rule validator refuses: `severity` `error` (the spec default), `active` not `false`, `events` covering `update` (the default covers it). An undeclared from-state stays unconstrained, and several applicable rules on one field intersect. It reads the declared transition map for choice controls; it does not import, mirror or wire the deprecated object-level rule engine (`validation-engine-stays-unwired.test.ts` still green).
- **`@object-ui/plugin-form` — the narrowing runs in `gateFormFields`**, the one field-gate step every form layout draws its resolved fields through. It takes an optional `previousValues` (the persisted record) and narrows a single-value select on both carriers: the entry's own `options` (the form renderer's built-in select) and `field.options` (the registered select widget). All six layouts pass their persisted record: the simple form, `ModalForm`, `DrawerForm`, `TabbedForm`, `SplitForm` and `WizardForm`. The from-state is the stored row, never the live value. A create form is unconstrained, and the current value always stays offered.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid`** re-exports the helper from core, so `ObjectGrid.tsx` is untouched.

### Visible change in the grid's inline editor (intended)

The grid used to narrow on ANY `state_machine` rule for the field. It now narrows only on a rule the server enforces on update. A `severity: 'warning'` / `'info'` machine (for example the showcase `project_health_progression`), an `active: false` rule, or an `events: ['insert']` rule no longer narrows the inline editor: the server never refuses those moves, so every option is offered again.

### Why `gateFormFields` and not `ObjectForm.tsx` alone

The console's record edit dialog is `ModalForm`, rendered directly by `app-shell` `AppContent.tsx` (`formType: 'modal'`, `mode: 'edit'`), not `ObjectForm`'s default arm; `ObjectForm` also routes `drawer` / `tabbed` / `split` / `wizard` to their own files. Narrowing only the default arm would have left the reported dialog unchanged. The seat approved the wider file surface (Claim amendment on the card).

## Tests

Run at head `80690c5b` from `ui/` under the verify lock:

- `packages/core/src/validation/__tests__/state-machine-next-values.test.ts` (new, 12): default severity narrows; warning / info / inactive / insert-only do not; undeclared and empty from-states are unconstrained; several rules intersect; published from the package root.
- `packages/core/src/validation/__tests__/validation-engine-stays-unwired.test.ts` — still green.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/inline-edit-options.test.ts` — existing pins green, plus the warning-machine case.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/stateMachineOptions.test.ts` (new, 11): both carriers narrowed, create unconstrained, unloaded record unconstrained, warning keeps every option, string options, multi-value untouched, and through `gateFormFields`.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/stateMachineSelect-25933.test.tsx` (new, 5, rendered): the console edit dialog on a `backlog` task offers `backlog`, `todo`; an `in_review` task offers `in_progress`, `in_review`, `done`; the simple edit form on a `done` task offers `in_progress`, `done`; CONTROLS: a create dialog and a warning-severity machine offer all five.

Result: the five files above, 41 + 5 tests, all pass. The full `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/plugin-form` suites (`npx vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/core/ packages/plugin-form/`, 413 files, 6484 passed, 28 skipped) ran at `8e28b0ff`; their one red, `column-identity.ratchet.test.ts` reading `f?.name || f.multiple || f.field?.multiple` as a column-identity dual read, was fixed by splitting the guard and re-run green with the four pinned files. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core --filter @object-ui/plugin-form --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid run type-check`: exit 0. The `@object-ui/plugin-grid` suite was narrowed to `inline-edit-options.test.ts` (its only change is the re-export); the full grid suite is left to CI `Test Core`.

**Ablation** (fix committed first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk, restored to the HEAD blob): handing `narrowStateMachineOptions` `previousValues: undefined` inside `gateFormFields` turned the 4 narrowing pins red (the `gateFormFields` unit pin and the three rendered narrowing pins) while the 12 others, controls included, stayed green.

**Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 46 commands at `573a23e7`; 45 exited 0 there. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` was red there because the record predated the last source commit; after the re-record it exits 0 at the final head `80690c5b`, whose only further change is `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`. `--ran` reconciliation: 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: every row carries its exit code). Repo-wide scans (`pnpm lint`, the full `check:*` farm) are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- The wizard narrows from `persistedRecord`, the record as first read; it does not advance after a mid-flow save. The wizard only writes at its final commit, so this matches its own `previousValues`.
- Only top-level `state_machine` rules narrow. A `state_machine` nested inside a `conditional` rule's `then` / `otherwise` is not read; that leaves the control permissive, never stricter than the server.
- The refusal message after submit is unchanged; it still does not name the allowed next states. With the select narrowed the user should no longer reach it from the form.
